title: Submartingale from an absorbed fair walk
statement:
For every $\delta>0$, there is a $\tau_0>0$ such that the following holds. Let $(\Omega,\mathcal F,\mu)$ be a probability space with a filtration $(\mathcal F_t)_{t\in\mathbb N}$, and let $Y_t:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be an absorbed fair walk with midpoint $a$, barrier distance $b$, and step size $\tau$. Suppose $b>0$, $0<\tau\le\tau_0$, $\delta\le a-b$, $a+b\le1-\delta$, and $b=m\tau$ for some natural number $m$. Then the process
\[
 t\longmapsto \sqrt{U(Y_t)^2+\tau^2t}
\]
is a submartingale with respect to the filtration, where $U$ is the closed Gaussian profile.
